name: Standing 6-DOF Body Pose Controller
description: Fine-grained torso orientation and height controller while standing, continuously mapping roll, pitch, yaw, and squat commands to compliant leg and neck adjustments.
details: Developed for the community microduck_runtime port. Utilizes the full 6-dim body_pose command vector (tx, ty, tz, roll, pitch, yaw) in the standard 61-dim observation contract. Allows interactive puppeteering of the duck's stance height, torso tilt, and look-around angles without shifting foot contact locations.

verification.summary: Community reference only; the published artifact exposes a legacy 51-D input and is not compatible with the registry contract.
verification.hardware_target: MicroDuck Raspberry Pi SBC / Dynamixel XL330
verification.notes: Not deployable through the standard 61-D runtime. Replace the artifact with a 61-D ONNX model and re-test before claiming hardware compatibility.

contract.actuator_model: Dynamixel XL330 (BAM M6 voltage control law)

media.caption: MicroDuck modulating torso roll and pitch while maintaining stable foot contact
